correctness.rationale: A shortest path flips each differing coordinate exactly once; if it has length less than five it extends along an unused coordinate. Thus maximal geodesics are the 16 antipodal pairs times 5! flip orders, using one start per pair to avoid reversal. Each is an induced path, so distinct undirected paths have distinct vertex masks. Any path's distances from a fixed center run in unit steps from r to 5-r, which forces a visit to distance two; shells have ten vertices. Translation lets any nonempty candidate be moved to contain zero. The independent exhaustive replay generated 1920 path masks, including 1560 that avoid zero, and tested all 7888725 normalized sets of size nine, with none hitting all masks, and all 20160075 normalized sets of size ten, with exactly ten passing. These were exactly the shells centered at distance two from zero; all 32 shells were verified distinct and valid. Adding a vertex never destroys transversality, so exclusion at nine excludes every smaller size. Undoing the normalization proves completeness of the 32-set family.
residual_risks: The lower bound and classification are computer-assisted finite exhaustion; the uploaded C++ checker was not executed and the independent run is not formal verification. No conclusion for other dimensions follows.
